task.title: Day-not-yet-started orchestration

evidence.text: Blocked before implementation: the active carrier only exposes the narrower begin_today vault command. The specified first-day cold-start lifecycle requires real vault.day.ensure, khora.session_start, and first-session tarot/Mercurius orchestration RPC seams, none of which are present in the carrier/substrate source. No UI-only affordance was added because it could not execute the required lifecycle.
Reopened with vault.day.ensure, khora.session_start, and first-session oracle orchestration made substrate scope.
